title: Bunk hearing George Mitchell on Jelly Roll records
summary: Bunk discovered George Mitchell's playing on Jelly Roll records at the Loughboroughs; Russell recalls 1943 California.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I remember there was one time when Bunker staying at Loft was up later that they got to playing him some jelly roll records and he became very enamored of George Mitchell's playing which he had apparently he had never been aware of how fine Mitchell was and I remember he kept saying how about playing the pearls for me again or what I forget which one it was one of those jelly roll things that Mitchell plays very

well on it we played some of those in California for him in 1943 I know and he made a second coronet part to one of those I have the record some place I just remembered yeah with jelly's band on the phonograph he played in the recorder and the band in the background
from there yeah I left it here really yeah yeah yeah yeah
